items.quote: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark
items.claim: The ark was assembled by sequentially placing the testimony inside, staves on its exterior, and mercy seat positioned above
items.mechanism: sequential placement of ark components in layered configuration

items.quote: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony
items.claim: The assembled ark was transported into the tabernacle and concealed with a covering veil
items.mechanism: veil covering procedure to conceal ark contents
